description: This file manages the interactions for a wide viewport search bar in a Drupal theme, including toggling visibility, handling focus, and click outside events.

methods.name: searchIsVisible
methods.description: Checks if the search wrapper contains the 'is-active' class, indicating visibility.

methods.name: watchForClickOut
methods.description: Closes the search bar if a click occurs outside the search wrapper or button.

methods.name: watchForFocusOut
methods.description: Closes the search bar when focus moves outside the search area, with Safari compatibility.

methods.name: watchForEscapeOut
methods.description: Closes the search bar when the Escape key is pressed.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the search input when the search bar is visible, or returns focus to the button.

methods.name: toggleSearchVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides the search bar, updates ARIA attributes, and manages event listeners.
